limits: Not percentage of all DDA content, source lines, map tiles or work hours
Groups have very different sizes; this is a transparent coarse meter
Generation-tested scopes include isolated previews and approved additions to existing BN locations
Not a claim of full player traversal, quest completion or final release acceptance
Other partially staged packages are not credited as finished
A pending new patch does not invalidate historical evidence, but must pass its own tests
